(2) `implemented` is set by hand by qa-engineer; a `release implemented` verb is candidate 3's governance-verbs scope. (6) Part-1 `Measured by:` pointers were repointed in this closure without a new decision record, as artifact renames rather than principle changes (the rationale ADR 0004 recorded): P-13 `dadaia specs doctor` -> `dadaia doctor`; P-20's statement named the deleted `specs doctor` command and now names `dadaia doctor` (same ratchet test, ceiling moved 10 -> 8); P-24 `-k v27` -> `-k v31` (the named test never existed; V31 is the intent ceiling per tier).
